ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites will be enforced. This course will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, April 15, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Informatics Minor students on Monday, April 22, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. The course considers how social media provides a new platform for unprecedented collaboration, new ways of engaging customers, and the benefits and challenges of social media. The course will take a strategic approach by helping students understand the business impact on the firm and building the requisite skills to create value in this new reality.
